camel_example: aliyun vpcpeer TagResources --region cn-hangzhou --ResourceId.1 'pcc-bp16qjewdsunr41m10000' --Tag.1.Key FinanceDept --Tag.1.Value FinanceJoshua --ResourceType PeerConnection --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou'
description_en: Creates and attaches tags to VPC peering connections
description_zh: 调用TagResources接口为指定的VPC对等连接统一创建并绑定标签
kebab_example: aliyun vpcpeer tag-resources --resource-id pcc-bp16qjewdsunr41m10000 --tag Value=FinanceJoshua Key=FinanceDept --resource-type PeerConnection --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: TagResources

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource. You can specify up to 20 resource IDs
parameters.help_zh: 资源ID，最多支持输入20个资源ID
parameters.name: resource_id

fields.help_en:
The tag key. You must specify 1 to 20 tag keys. The tag key cannot be an empty string.

The tag key can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`. It cannot contain `http://` or `https://`
fields.help_zh:
资源的标签键。至少输入1个标签键，最多支持输入20个标签键。一旦传入该值，则不允许为空字符串。

最多支持 128 个字符，不能以`aliyun`和`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`
fields.name: key

fields.help_en:
The tag value. You must specify 1 to 20 tag values. The tag value can be an empty string.

The tag value can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`. It cannot contain `http://` or `https://`
fields.help_zh:
资源的标签值。至少输入1个标签值，最多支持输入20个标签值。一旦传入该值，可以为空字符串。

最多支持 128 个字符，不能以`aliyun`和`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en: The resource type. Set the value to PeerConnection
parameters.help_zh: 资源类型。取值：PeerConnection，表示VPC对等连接
parameters.name: resource_type

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

Generate a unique token for each request from your client. The token can contain only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId of the request as the ClientToken. The RequestId of each request may be different
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the region where the resource is located.

For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html
parameters.help_zh:
要创建并绑定标签的资源所在的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the tags were created and attached. Valid values:

true

false
Success.description_zh:
是否创建并绑定成功。取值：

true：创建并绑定成功。
false：创建并绑定失败
